short adjective

of a vowel or syllable

also short vowel, short syllable, shorten a vowel, short mark, breve

classical

Quint. 1.7.3: eadem littera nōminātīvō cāsū brevis, ablātīvō longa est
Quint. 9.4.86: a brevis, gre brevis (Lewis & Short)
Traupman 248

brevis, breve

Declension on Wiktionary

short (of a vowel or syllable)

To shorten a vowel or syllable is corripere (Quint. 1.5.18), and a shortened syllable correpta; to pronounce a vowel short, correptē prōnūntiāre (Traupman 248; correptē dīcere, Gell. 2.17.5). A short mark is nota brevis (Traupman 247).

Other words

  • correptus, correpta, correptum — shortened, short

    also used · classical · Quint. 1.5.18: sīve cum syllaba correpta prōdūcitur; Traupman 248 · Declension on Wiktionary

Examples

  • palus aliud priōre syllabā longā aliud sequentī significat

    palus means one thing with the first syllable long, another with the secondQuint. 1.7.3

See also long, vowel, syllable, short.
